extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians in arithmetic geometry/number theory, especially readers of Mochizuki's Inter-Universal Teichmüller (IUT) series
extracted.subtask_description: Exposition and formal statements (definitions, propositions, theorems) concerning Θ±ell‑Hodge theaters, Θ×μ/Θ×μ_gau links, mono-theta environments, cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms, and related group- and Frobenioid-theoretic constructions in the context of Mochizuki's IUT theory. Contains technical constructions and compatibility results rather than evaluation checklists.
